name: Your step: Approve an Actor publication
description: Reusable owner-only publication gate. Each of the first three distinct Actor publications requires its own approval.
goal: Show the owner the exact Store listing and price for one distinct Actor publication.

config.prompt: Your step: For each of the first three distinct Actor publications, run this approval separately. Record the new Actor's unique name, have a different engine review its code and Store listing (the current Mississippi listing is ventures/apify-tools/store_listing.md), confirm its event price, included platform usage, run limit and disabled automatic apify-default-dataset-item charge, then publish it yourself in Apify Console. Never reuse an earlier approval for another Actor. Stop before publication if the different-engine review is missing.
